meta.model_usage: display_only; does not feed Model A, game projections, signals, or bracketology
meta.methodology: Three-season blend of THI opponent-adjusted offensive and defensive efficiency, centered within each season's scoring environment and conservatively shrunk 12% toward the national mean.
meta.validation_target: future-season rank ordering, not betting ROI
meta.current_season_update_policy: Verified current-season adjusted efficiency blends from 0% to an 85% cap over the first 12 games. The immutable preseason board remains the movement reference.
